A '''Naboo crest''' was a type of headdress worn by the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]]. Made of [[Color/Legends|bronze]]-colored [[Orichalc/Legends|orichalc]] metal,<ref name="AOTC VD" /> the crest consisted of a skullcap with a protruding, halo-like disc<ref name="FF 125">{{FactFile|125|GAR 13-14|Garments and Couture}}</ref> decorated with a [[flower of life emblem]].<ref name="AOTC VD" />

[[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] wore one as part of [[Gender/Legends|her]] [[Thousand Moons young matron's dress]] to disguise herself as a [[Refugee/Legends|refugee]].<ref name="AOTC VD" /> She covered the ornate crest with an ocher-colored lace veil while in transit.<ref name="Episode II">{{Film|II}}</ref>
